plan.title: Tesla Telemetry Webhooks — streaming ingest, IFTTT pipeline, location AI, cost-safety
plan.description: Outbound-WebSocket Durable Object holds Tessie Fleet Telemetry (push, no cron) into TESLA_DB; IFTTT park/drive-away pipeline (soft-arrival on park, finalize-with-dwell on drive-away); enriched location MCP tools; full 0022 surface. Two mandatory cost-safety systems: DO-alarm circuit breaker (from the $700 runaway) and per-API Google quota hard-block. See docs/0023_tesla_telemetry_webhooks/{IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN,DESIGN_SPEC,PROMPT}.md and preview changelog /admin/changelog/preview/tesla-telemetry-webhooks.

legend.note: Mirrors D1 plan_tasks 1:1 (seeded via submit_feature_proposal). Phases: 0=Safety A, 1=Safety B, 2=Ingest, 3=P1 visit-logs, 4=P2 config, 5=P3 pipeline, 6=P4 HITL, 7=P5 nav, 8=P6 location AI, 9=P7 discovery+voice.
